estimator_contract.p95: bounded asymmetric moving proxy; a fresh profile remains within its observed value range
estimator_contract.p99: all-history observed maximum until a persisted rolling window is implemented
estimator_contract.safety_argument: For the configured 50-sample window, nearest-rank empirical p99 is the window maximum. The all-history maximum is therefore conservative: it can retain a stale outlier but cannot undercut an observed completion.

regression_cases.name: rare high outlier
regression_cases.property: p99 remains 1000 and never falls below p95

migration.existing_profiles: may retain a historically inflated persisted percentile because raw order statistics were not stored; the retained value is conservative for output capping
migration.experiment_policy: Every protocol stage already requires fresh per-arm Agentc storage, so legacy profiles cannot enter calibration, pilot, or confirmatory results
migration.follow_up: bd-bwgu tracks a persisted bounded-window design that can age out old observations safely

interpretation_limits: This is a deterministic synthetic Stage E0 regression screen, not evidence of provider-token savings or task quality.
The all-history maximum deliberately trades responsiveness for safety until bd-bwgu lands.
The p95 field remains a bounded proxy rather than an exact order statistic and must be described as such in any analysis using it.
